messages:
alex: Hi folks — quick Q about returning from parental leave. Thinking of a 6-week phased return (3 days/week) before full-time. Is that supported under Redwood policy? Also how does PTO/benefits proration work during ramp-up?

sam-peopleops: Congrats Alex! Yes, we support phased returns. We call it 'ramp schedule' in our policy. You can request up to 8 weeks of flexible schedule at reduced hours. We'll need the formal request form and manager sign-off. docs: https://intranet/redwood/leave

alex: Great, what form do I submit? Is it the same as the standard parental leave paperwork?

sam-peopleops: Use the 'Post-Leave Flexible Work Request' form (link above). Attach your original leave approval and expected return date. Manager must fill the 'Operational Coverage' section.

dave-mgr: Alex — happy to sign. Two notes: 1) for oncall, we need coverage for the first two weeks of reduced days; 2) if you return Tue/Thu/Fri, can you make Tue a heavy collaboration day? Also ping me once HR confirms payroll adjustments.

alex: Yep Tue/Thu/Fri works. For coverage I can coordinate with Linda to swap rotation.

linda: I can take the first two oncall weeks. No prob.

sam-peopleops: Payroll/benefits: while on reduced hours, healthcare premiums continue (company covers same %), but base salary is pro-rated. Vacation accrual switches to part-time rate starting the first payroll after HR processes the change. It usually takes one payroll cycle, so expect the adjustment on the next paycheck.

maria: Is there any impact on 401k vesting or retirement contributions during the ramp?

sam-peopleops: Good Q — contributions are pro-rated with salary; vesting schedules are unaffected. If you have matching contributions, the company match will follow the salary contributions.

alex: Thanks all — last question: do I need medical documentation for the ramp portion or just for leave start?

sam-peopleops: For ramp itself, we only require a note if it's part of a medical accommodation. If it's voluntary phased return, manager approval + form is enough.

hr-bot: Reminder: please submit the 'Post-Leave Flexible Work Request' at least 10 business days before return to ensure payroll and coverage coordination. :calendar:

alex: Filing now. Thanks everyone! :raised_hands:
